thesis: J: 'things just ping-pong between levels'. Fade the edge of a qualified two-level range: when price tags the zone of one of two adjacent, prior-touched, role-consistent levels bounding the current price and rejects back toward the other level, enter toward the range interior (puts at the upper level, calls at the lower level). Both directions.
single_pass_commitment: The grid below is run EXACTLY ONCE over the tuning population and once over the held-out population in the same pass. No knob, threshold, or definition may change after results are seen. Honest nulls expected.

fixed_structural_choices_not_tuned.level_source: backtest/lib/watchers/level_memory.py LevelMemory (the LIVE engine's multi-day level perception layer), lookback_days=5 (its production default), UNMODIFIED constants (CLUSTER_TOL 0.35, TOUCH_TOL 0.20, BREAK_MARGIN 0.15, MIN_PIVOTS 2). Never an invented level set.
fixed_structural_choices_not_tuned.bar_universe: 5m SPY RTH bars (09:30<=t<16:00 TRUE ET), per-day source file exactly as chosen by the day inventory's dedupe (analysis/edge-matrix/day-inventory-2026-07-23.json), rows deduped by timestamp. RTH-only for uniformity: premarket coverage differs by source-file era, so premarket bars are excluded everywhere to keep the detector identical across the population (disclosed limitation vs J's premarket-level thesis).
fixed_structural_choices_not_tuned.context_frame: For day D: RTH bars of the 4 prior inventory-covered days (each from its own inventory-chosen source file) + day D. Gives LevelMemory its 5-day lookback and the ribbon its EMA warmup. Earliest days in the population have fewer prior days (disclosed).
fixed_structural_choices_not_tuned.timestamp_frame: et-v2 (parse stored offset -> UTC -> America/New_York -> naive true ET) for BOTH SPY and OPRA caches, per lib/et_frame.py + the DST-frame audit; frame-consistent joins, no winter 1h misalignment.
range_qualification_at_bar_i: levels = LevelMemory.levels_at(i, lookback_days=5) (CAUSAL: bars <= i only)
U = nearest level ABOVE close_i with role=='resistance' and touches >= k2
L = nearest level BELOW close_i with role=='support' and touches >= k2

tag_and_reject_trigger.put_at_U: high_i >= U - k3 AND close_i < U AND low_i > L + k3 (no simultaneous tag of both zones)
tag_and_reject_trigger.call_at_L: low_i <= L + k3 AND close_i > L AND high_i < U - k3
tag_and_reject_trigger.zone_semantics: Levels are ZONES, never penny-exact (J 2026-07-17): a tag is the bar's extreme entering the +-k3 zone; a reject is the close back on the range-interior side.

fixed_structural_choices_not_tuned.confirm_knob_semantics: c=0: decision bar = tag bar i, enter at its close. c=1: decision bar = i+1, requires close_{i+1} strictly inside (L, U); enter at close of i+1. Levels/U/L are frozen from the tag bar's snapshot.
fixed_structural_choices_not_tuned.entry_window_et: decision-bar close time in [09:35, 15:30] (live 09:35 entry gate; 15:30 cutoff leaves room before the 15:50 time stop)
fixed_structural_choices_not_tuned.position_discipline: One position at a time (live doctrine). A new signal is only eligible after the prior walk's exit_time. No adds, no pyramiding.
fixed_structural_choices_not_tuned.direction: BOTH (P at U, C at L) per validation-is-the-only-scope
fixed_structural_choices_not_tuned.sizing: qty=3 contracts (Safe minimum: 2 TP1 + 1 runner; tp1_qty_fraction 0.667 -> int(3*0.667)=2). Fixed, never tuned.
fixed_structural_choices_not_tuned.strike: ATM = round(decision-bar SPY close), per crypto/lib/strike_selection.py V15_SAFE_TIERS (live core Safe truth, fills-verified 2026-07-11).

fill_model.entry: First 5m OPRA bar of backtest/data/options/SPY{yymmdd}{P|C}{strike*1000:08d}.csv at/after the decision-bar close instant; entry premium = that bar's VWAP (the documented option_pricing_real convention). The entry bar must start within 5 minutes of the decision close or the episode is NOT a real fill (stale-fill honesty guard).
fill_model.real_fills_only: Missing/empty contract CSV or no qualifying entry bar => n_signals counts it, n_real_fills does not; NO BS-synthetic substitution anywhere in gate math. BS-synthetic is not used at all in this study.
fill_model.exit: backtest/lib/exit_manager_walk.walk_exit_manager over the SAME contract's 5m bars — the REAL live exit_manager decision core. Its documented fill conventions apply (limit stages at level, market stages at close minus $0.02 slippage, point-sample at bar open, data-exhausted force close disclosed).

exit_shape_frozen.source: automation/state/fleet/strategies.py RIBBON_RIDE.exit.to_dict() — the LIVE shape, entry-side tuning ONLY per protocol
exit_shape_frozen.trigger_level_rule: the tagged level: U for puts (structure stop when a CLOSED 5m SPY bar closes above U = range top actually broke), L for calls (closed 5m below L). This is the family's natural chart invalidation and matches v15.3 chart-stop-primary.
exit_shape_frozen.ribbon_flip_exits: ACTIVE, live periods (backtest/lib/ribbon.py: fast 13 / pivot 20 / slow 48 EMA on 5m RTH closes, multi-day continuous, causal SMA-seeded EMA). Opt-bar row k uses the stack of the last CLOSED SPY 5m bar at that row's instant. WARMUP/MIXED never flips.

population.heldout: the inventory's frozen heldout_days list (96 days, 2026-02-25..2026-07-17, last 25% of OPRA days BY DATE). Used ONLY for held_out_total and gate 4; never inspected during tuning (there IS no iterative tuning — one frozen pass).

per_cell_outputs.n_signals: count of decision-bar signals on tuning days (position-discipline applied), incl. signals with no real fill
per_cell_outputs.n_real_fills: episodes with a real OPRA entry fill + walk, tuning days
per_cell_outputs.expectancy: mean per-trade dollar P&L (qty=3), tuning real fills
per_cell_outputs.total_pnl: sum of per-trade P&L, tuning real fills
per_cell_outputs.day_wr: fraction of covered tuning days (>=1 real fill) whose day P&L > 0
per_cell_outputs.ex_top3_total: total_pnl minus the 3 largest per-trade P&Ls
per_cell_outputs.held_out_total: sum of per-trade P&L on heldout days (same frozen cell params)
per_cell_outputs.p_raw: one-sided sign-flip permutation test on tuning per-trade P&Ls: 10000 iterations, numpy seed 42, p = (1 + #{perm_mean >= observed_mean}) / 10001

causality_contract: Detector at bar i reads ONLY bars <= i (C6). Enforced structurally (LevelMemory.levels_at(i)) AND assert-checked in code: (a) runtime asserts that every level's first_seen_idx/last_touch_idx <= i; (b) a truncation self-test on 3 fixed dates (2025-03-19, 2025-11-14, 2026-01-13) asserting that signals computed on a frame truncated at mid-day bar k are identical to full-frame signals restricted to decision bars <= k. Runner refuses to produce results if the self-test fails.
